vetSays.line: 🛡️ Hazel, the person in their 40s, with grey-streaked hair, Nancy and Kawthar met them at the door — 4 put down. Hazel, the person in their 40s, with grey-streaked hair, Nancy, Kawthar are hurt.
🛡️ Kavya, Nancy, Kawthar and Jack met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Kavya, Nancy, Kawthar, Jack are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Amina, Liam and Sigrun met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Amina, Liam, Sigrun are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sigrun just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikos just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Nikos met them at the door — 1 put down. Nikos is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Nikos taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Nikos: "Ground Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Liam showed David the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Fireside lesson: Nikos passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Phuoc just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Phuoc just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Phuoc met them at the door — 1 put down. Phuoc is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Phuoc met them at the door — 1 put down. Phuoc is hurt.
🛡️ Bonnie and Ultan met them at the door — 2 put down. Bonnie, Ultan are hurt.
🛡️ Bonnie and Ultan met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Bonnie, Ultan are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Bonnie just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
